CANDIDATES.DUPLICATE_RISK: LOW-MEDIUM: no local Security/Forensics task exists. Keep this about forensic collection authority, attempt reconciliation, custody, and coverage—not a generic distributed job queue, storage engine, security observability dashboard, or timeline query product.
EDGE_FAILURE_SURFACE: endpoint disappears after plan approval but before collection
offline bundle arrives after the live attempt expired
same delivery identity repeats with a changed payload
duplicate content digest occurs under different case/source authority
worker lease expires while a delayed completion arrives
collection reaches byte/time budget with incomplete source coverage
malformed manifest or digest mismatch fails closed
restart between result acceptance and coverage publication
case hold or revoked policy blocks release while preserving custody evidence
CANDIDATES.ENGINEERING_OBJECTIVE: Complete an inherited forensic collection control plane so case-scoped acquisition plans, endpoint/offline collection attempts, immutable evidence manifests, trust decisions, and collection-coverage reporting reconcile correctly through retries and restarts.
CANDIDATES.INHERITED_SYSTEM_STATE: A synthetic but varied estate of endpoint identities, platform capabilities, collection policies, existing case requests, offline collector bundles, prior attempts, artifact metadata, and event/custody history; data-backed scale can naturally use 10,000-20,000 deterministic primary records without real host data or credentials.
CANDIDATES.INSTRUCTION_FIT: PASS: the request can describe case-scoped authorized acquisition, trustworthy provenance, partial-result accounting, restart-safe operation, and deterministic coverage/export in <=20 concise bullets; technical schemas and protocols can remain legitimate operator documentation.
PARTIAL_FIX_TRAPS: Retrying transport without attempt fencing can let delayed results from an old collection overwrite a newer attempt.
Hashing an item without binding endpoint, case, source, and collection attempt does not establish custody or prevent cross-case reuse.
Counting only successful artifacts hides required sources that are unavailable, partial, rejected, or never attempted.
Persisting collection results but not queue claims/checkpoints can duplicate logical evidence after restart.
Accepting event payload claims without source authority can let untrusted client-originated events impersonate server dispositions.
CANDIDATES.PERSONA: Incident-response evidence custodian coordinating authorized live-endpoint and offline-image collections across a mixed fleet.
PRESERVATION_OBLIGATIONS: Existing case, endpoint, collection, and artifact identifiers remain stable.
Never overwrite prior evidence or rewrite custody history; corrections append a new event.
Unauthorized, stale, malformed, or conflicting collection events fail closed without changing unrelated cases.
Offline evidence remains ingestible without network access and retains its original source identity.
A restart or retry must not lose accepted evidence or create duplicate published items.
CANDIDATES.REASONING_CHAIN: Resolve case and endpoint authority -> validate policy and source compatibility -> schedule an attempt under budget/deadline -> accept only matching trusted attempt events -> reconcile collected bytes and digest/provenance -> reduce partial outcomes -> derive coverage and export from committed custody state.

CANDIDATES.REQUIRED_END_STATE: Operators can submit a case-bound collection plan, see each requested source reach a terminal collected/partial/unavailable/rejected disposition, verify the resulting content and provenance manifest, resume safely after worker or coordinator restart, and export a case package whose reported coverage and custody chain agree with the persisted evidence. No real endpoint, credentials, or external service is needed in grading.
REQUIREMENT_FAMILIES: case and endpoint identity normalization with tenant/case ownership fences
policy-authorized live versus offline acquisition planning and source compatibility
attempt, delivery, and content-digest idempotency with stale-worker fencing
bounded collection budgets, deadlines, and partial/unavailable dispositions
source trust and client/server authority for collection events
immutable item provenance, custody transitions, and append-only audit evidence
restart-safe scheduling, recovery, and exactly-once logical publication
coverage accounting and deterministic case-manifest export
CANDIDATES.SCALE_FIT: PRELIMINARY PASS: a real collection control plane naturally spans case/policy resolution, endpoint capability inventory, planning, scheduling, worker leases, trust/event ingestion, artifact custody, recovery, coverage, and publication. These differentiated responsibilities plausibly support >=3,000 substantive reachable LOC and 20-30 causally related manifestations; A2 must validate the clean architecture can support the scale and 25-30 organic F2P cases before topology or starter work begins.

CANDIDATES.DUPLICATE_RISK: MEDIUM-HIGH: shares conceptual surface with event-time-session-window-processor and resembles Timesketch/Plaso. If pursued, differentiate through forensic source provenance, event-quality traits, import truth, and case evidence completeness rather than generic windowing or search.
EDGE_FAILURE_SURFACE: DST fold/gap and explicit offset disagreement
corrupt/recovered/incomplete parser disposition
nested-field mapping exhaustion
duplicate identity with changed payload
late source arrival after publication
zero-event import with successful transport
restart during index/manifest publication
CANDIDATES.ENGINEERING_OBJECTIVE: Complete a case timeline pipeline that normalizes source-native events, preserves source and recovery traits, reconciles clock uncertainty and duplicate observations, and publishes only when import and analysis state are truthful.
CANDIDATES.INHERITED_SYSTEM_STATE: Synthetic case evidence from multiple operating systems and sources, event rows with mixed timestamp provenance, parser dispositions, and previous case generations.
CANDIDATES.INSTRUCTION_FIT: PASS: can be stated as a case-timeline completion request with explicit provenance, uncertainty, import truth, and publication requirements.
PARTIAL_FIX_TRAPS: UTC sorting alone loses clock uncertainty and source-time evidence.
Event deduplication without source lineage can erase corroborating observations.
A parser's recovered or incomplete event can be incorrectly upgraded to ordinary evidence.
A mapping estimate that ignores nested fields can accept an import that indexes zero rows while reporting ready.
CANDIDATES.PERSONA: Forensic analyst reconciling event evidence from endpoint logs, audit records, and offline image parsers into a reviewable case timeline.
PRESERVATION_OBLIGATIONS: Preserve source event identity and original timestamp values.
Do not silently discard duplicate-looking events from independent sources.
Do not label a zero-event or partial import ready.
CANDIDATES.REASONING_CHAIN: Validate source manifest -> parse and normalize -> retain source-time plus normalized-time -> classify event quality -> deduplicate/correlate -> index under bounded mappings -> reconcile import errors -> publish readiness and coverage.

CANDIDATES.REQUIRED_END_STATE: A case operator receives a deterministic event timeline and source-coverage report; events retain their original timestamps, source identities, and recovered/corrupt/incomplete traits; incomplete imports cannot appear complete; and prior case data is not mixed into the active case.
CANDIDATES.SCALE_FIT: POSSIBLE BUT CONDITIONAL: ingestion, normalization, source adapters, uncertainty-aware ordering, case-generation fencing, quality traits, mapping/capacity management, and export form a coherent system, but this direction is closer to existing event-time processing and public timeline products. Require A2 to show substantial architecture beyond a parser/indexing repair before choosing it for strict scale.

CANDIDATES.DUPLICATE_RISK: MEDIUM: custody/package integrity is semantically distinct, but a generic hash-verified filesystem service could resemble stonevault-crash-safe-storage. Keep forensic authority, holds, custody transitions, and release authorization central.
EDGE_FAILURE_SURFACE: hold arrives during export
referenced artifact reaches retention boundary
same evidence ID arrives with different bytes
custody transfer repeats or is out of order
authorization changes between plan and publish
crash during package publication
missing evidence in an otherwise valid manifest
CANDIDATES.ENGINEERING_OBJECTIVE: Complete an evidence-custody service that records acquisition provenance, validation state, custody transfers, legal holds, retention, and export manifests while preserving prior evidence and failing closed on incomplete verification.
CANDIDATES.INHERITED_SYSTEM_STATE: A varied synthetic catalog of case files, acquisition sources, custody events, review/hold states, export requests, retention references, and prior sealed packages.
CANDIDATES.INSTRUCTION_FIT: PASS: the operational work request can center on accountable evidence lifecycle, safe release, and reproducible handoff.
PARTIAL_FIX_TRAPS: Rehashing data does not establish who acquired or transferred it.
Deleting expired objects can invalidate a still-referenced package.
Exporting files before authorization checks can leak metadata or content.
A partially written export manifest can imply completeness after restart.
CANDIDATES.PERSONA: Evidence custodian managing retained forensic items, holds, access decisions, and reproducible case handoffs.
PRESERVATION_OBLIGATIONS: Custody history is append-only and corrections retain prior facts.
Holds prevent release/deletion without destroying evidence.
Unauthorized export produces no partial package or metadata side channel.
CANDIDATES.REASONING_CHAIN: Authenticate case scope -> validate acquisition manifest -> append custody event -> apply hold/retention decision -> select authorized evidence -> stage and hash export -> atomically publish package and audit outcome.

CANDIDATES.SCALE_FIT: POSSIBLE: custody workflow, authorization, retention, evidence-reference graph, export transactions, audit, and recovery can form a substantial system with real coupling. However, the stateful package/manifest core risks looking like a forensic reskin of existing storage tasks unless policy, access, and chain-of-custody workflows are primary.

Adjacent systems tasks exist in distributed leases, security observability, artifact policy, event-time processing, and crash-safe storage; the recommended package must remain specifically about forensic collection authority, source trust, custody, and coverage, and must not become a generic queue, security dashboard, event-window processor, or KV engine. Portfolio taxonomy counts show Security has AppSec tasks but no Forensics task.
outputs.WHY_THIS_ONE: P1 is the only candidate that makes forensic acquisition authority and evidence completeness the central engineering objective while naturally integrating live endpoint collections with offline bundles. It has coupled policy, endpoint capability, attempt fencing, event trust, evidence provenance, partial-result, recovery, and coverage responsibilities; those are more than a parser defect or a storage-engine reskin. The public sources ground realistic trust, atomicity, partial-hash, and multi-source acquisition concerns without dictating implementation. The scale/F2P fit remains provisional until A2 produces a clean design and A3 confirms a causal topology without padding. Recommended final identity: forensic-evidence-acquisition-control-plane.
